metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../skills/orrery/references/diagram.schema.json title: How orrery works subtitle: One YAML spec in, five formats out, with official icons and automatic layout direction: down legend: solid: Processing flow dotted: Icon lookup groups: author: { type: zone, label: You or your agent } engine: { type: boundary, label: "orrery CLI (bundled, no install)" } catalog: { type: zone, label: Bundled icon packs, in: engine } libs: { type: zone, label: "npm libraries (fetched, cached)" } outputs: { type: zone, label: Outputs } nodes: agent: { icon: tabler:robot, label: Agent or editor, in: author } spec: { icon: si:yaml, label: diagram.yaml, note: "nodes, groups, edges", in: author } validate: { icon: tabler:list-check, label: Validate, note: DG1xx codes with fixes, in: engine } aws: { icon: aws:category-compute, label: AWS, note: 810 icons, in: catalog } azure: { icon: azure:virtual-machine, label: Azure, note: 636 icons, in: catalog } gcp: { icon: gcp:cloud-run, label: Google Cloud, note: 233 icons, in: catalog } k8s: { icon: k8s:kubernetes, label: Kubernetes, note: 40 icons, in: catalog } more: { icon: tabler:library, label: "Octicons, Carbon, logos, Tabler, Phosphor", note: "16,490 icons", in: libs } layout: { icon: tabler:hierarchy-3, label: ELK layout, in: engine } check: { icon: tabler:ruler-measure, label: Check, note: DG2xx layout checks, in: engine } render: { icon: tabler:brush, label: Render, in: engine } svg: { icon: logos:svg, label: SVG, in: outputs } png: { icon: tabler:photo, label: PNG, in: outputs } drawio: { icon: si:diagramsdotnet, label: draw.io, in: outputs } tsx: { icon: logos:react, label: React TSX, in: outputs } html: { icon: logos:html-5, label: HTML viewer, in: outputs } edges: - agent -> spec: writes - spec -> validate -> layout -> check -> render - aws, azure, gcp, k8s ..> render # Render loads these on first use; written in layout order with the arrow flipped. - { from: render, to: more, arrow: start, line: dotted, label: first use } # Validate looks icon ids up in the bundled index; written in layout order with the arrow flipped. - { from: validate, to: catalog, arrow: start, line: dotted } - render -> svg, png, drawio, tsx, html

svg.title: How orrery works
svg.desc: How orrery works. 16 components in 5 groups. Connections: Agent or editor to diagram.yaml (writes); diagram.yaml to Validate; Validate to ELK layout; ELK layout to Check; Check to Render; AWS to Render; Azure to Render; Google Cloud to Render; Kubernetes to Render; Render to Octicons, Carbon, logos, Tabler, Phosphor (first use); Validate to Bundled icon packs; Render to SVG; Render to PNG; Render to draw.io; Render to React TSX; Render to HTML viewer.

text.tspan: One YAML spec in, five formats out, with official icons and automatic layout
